session.unconfigured: Supabase is not configured. Add the public project URL and publishable key to your local environment.
session.signedOut: Supabase client configured. You are signed out; authentication workflows are planned.
session.signedIn: An existing session was found. Farm workflows and permission loading are not implemented yet.
session.error: Session check failed. Check your Supabase configuration and connection.

auth.storyTitle: Better care. Better records. A better farm.
auth.storyDescription: One secure home for your dairy and cattle operations. Built around your farm, your people, and your language.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to your FarmLife workspace.
auth.unconfigured: Live sign-in is unavailable in this preview. Connect a secure backend before using real accounts.
auth.unconfirmed: Verify your email before signing in.
auth.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
auth.invalidInvitation: This invitation is invalid, expired, already used, or belongs to another email address.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
auth.lastOwner: The final owner cannot be removed. Assign another owner first.
auth.alreadyMember: You already belong to a workspace. Refresh your access.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.inviteOnly: Access is by invitation. Ask your organization owner for an account and workspace invitation.
auth.alreadySignedIn: You are signed in. Open your access settings
auth.recoveryDescription: Enter your email to request a password reset link.
auth.recoverySent: If this email has an account, a recovery link has been requested. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.resetDescription: Use a strong, unique password of at least 12 characters.
auth.accessFailed: Access could not be loaded. Check the backend connection and migration status.
auth.bootstrapDescription: You have no organization memberships. Accept an invitation from your owner, or create your own organization. Farm and branch setup will be available in the next module.
auth.inviteDescription: Create a single-use link for a verified account. Share it privately; it expires in seven days. New Auth accounts must first be provisioned by the administrator.
auth.linkCreated: Copy this private invitation link now. It is not stored in readable form.
auth.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the link manually.
auth.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? This cannot be undone.
auth.acceptDescription: Accept the invitation using the verified email address it was sent to. Access is checked again by the server.
auth.membersDescription: Review assigned access. Removing access takes effect immediately; the last owner is protected.
auth.confirmRemove: Remove this membership? The person will lose this role immediately.
